caption: CR3 gives the top-level page directory. Directory index 1 picks a page table, table index 3 picks the entry, and that entry points to frame 0x12 — physical address 0x12ABC for our offset. Notice the offset never passes through the tables.

spec.aria: A tree from CR3 to the page directory, through directory index 1 and table index 3, to page frame 0x12 at physical address 0x12ABC.
